subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR preserve the current ACP diagnostics, system-agent audit access, and Plugin SDK contracts before merge, or is a coordinated breaking change explicitly intended for the next release?
rationale: Repository policy defaults public SDK and documented CLI/API behavior to compatibility, but replacing the old path-shaped contracts requires an intentional inspection and deprecation design rather than a mechanical edit.

options.title: Preserve access contracts
options.body: Add SQLite-backed inspection or export APIs, retain a deprecated compatibility surface where necessary, and update all consumers before merging.

options.title: Approve coordinated break
options.body: Explicitly approve the removals, document upgrade impact, update every consumer and API baseline, and schedule the change under breaking-version policy.

options.title: Split contract-sensitive surfaces
options.body: Land internal journal migrations separately while deferring ACP, system-agent audit, and public SDK removals until replacement contracts are designed.

recommendation.title: Preserve access contracts
recommendation.body: Add SQLite-backed inspection or export APIs, retain a deprecated compatibility surface where necessary, and update all consumers before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The config and system-agent paths and this refactor are most closely connected to this contributor's sustained current-main work, with ACP and SQLite owners reviewing their respective contracts.
